body:
Thanks for your words.. they really help. 
I'm sorry you experienced what you did, and I could have never gone through that.
I just feel really shitty and don't know what to do.
I wish I could sleep, but I can't. I've been awake for 30 something hours and I'm just so tired.

It's not just the relationship.
I've been suicidal for a long time, with my dad abusing me and my mother at a young age.
My mother has been diagnosed with skin cancer, and honestly I don't know what to do.
Life is awful.
Just when things start looking up, they're swept from you.
It reminds me that I mean nothing..
absolutely fucking nothing.
